title: Could not go back in browser on nuxt
body:
It seems have some issue when you go back at router history. 
see your fork  https://codesandbox.io/s/zealous-firefly-2vktb?file=/package.json
If you change menu category, and then click browser back button. 
The url changed, but the state keep same

_Originally posted by @gfd6th in https://github.com/algolia/vue-instantsearch/issues/911#issuecomment-773429850_

comments.body: this is happening because the code there (arguably the one provided in the documentation) doesn't listen for route changes issued by vue router. I'm checking what the best option for that is and will get back
Here's a solution using vue router to listen for the back button: https://codesandbox.io/s/zealous-firefly-2vktb?file=/pages/index.vue
That example is highlighting the issue for me, not a solution. Highlighting any category, then hitting "back" the URL updates but state stays the same, which is what @gfd6th is explaining.
